goal: Explore three improvements to existing mechanics and three new mechanics that deepen trade without taking away from the main loop; implement only the ideas the council agrees on.

facts.text: Main loop: buy a resource, optionally send it to another planet's storage, sell it at a Sell order; income funds ships and upgrades; win on cycle and cash.
Already proposed and not to repeat: idle-stock next step, route pays-when line, full-lane upgrade (approved, built), saturation, delivery contracts, sell floor, backhaul (see design/proposals/).

decisions.text: The council (council.json in this folder) decides which ideas are built. An idea is built only when feature-designer, economy-designer and story-designer all vote agree on its final text. Implementation goes on branch new-features-test.

open_questions.text: Is system 3 needed? Owner has put it on hold; council ideas must not depend on it.
